Name: Push
Description: Pushed along the hit direction; no flinch motion

Name: Flinch
Description: Directional flinch motion (front or back); no push

Name: Knockdown
Description: Knocked down; speed set by a global battle setting

Name: Blow-away
Description: Launched away; speed from Blow-away Speed (Min/Max) and Blow-away Launch Ratio in global-battle-settings.csv; knockdown instead if the target lacks the blow-away motion or is airborne

Name: Hit Parameters Motion
Description: Plays the motion in Hit Parameters +40; no reaction on targets that lack that motion

Name: Hit Parameters Motion
Description: Same as 6; only outranks 6 when both land on the same frame
